layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for overdue digest
Add overdue digest tests and verification report

graderOnly: src/, test/, and package.json are identical to the commits the verification report and the existing implementation review assessed; the withdrawal and reselection commits changed only .standards/STATE.md.
node --test test/loans.test.js test/holds.test.js test/digest.test.js passes with 9 tests, and test/digest.test.js observes every acceptance condition AC-001 to AC-004.
The scope lists README changes as a non-goal, so no project documentation is required; no documentation record exists and Documenter never started its phase.

The existing Implementation-Reviewed Closure section says ELIGIBLE and its User Choice and User Reason describe the original cycle-start selection (internal job, no documentation changes expected), not the current reselection, whose stated reason (the user reviewed the README and decided it does not need to mention the digest) is only in Active Work.Request.

Every closure requirement passes on reassessment, so a correct run ends with one current closure section marked ELIGIBLE for the reselection, the old assessment under Closure Assessment History, and WorkflowState AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF via a FORWARD handoff from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project: small dependency-free Node ES-module library (loans, dates, mailer outbox, hold notices) with 4 passing tests. 10-design: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-004, README changes a non-goal), design, STATE at DEVELOPING with the original IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED choice in Request. 20-implement: src/digest.js (correct) and COMPLETE plan, STATE TESTING. 30-verify: test/digest.test.js (5 tests), package.json test script, COMPLETE FULL verification report citing the implementation commit, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 40-review: COMPLETE implementation review with one ELIGIBLE Implementation-Reviewed Closure section recording the original choice and reason, STATE AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. 50-withdraw: STATE DOCUMENTING, FULL_DELIVERABLE, COMPLETION_CHANGE from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. 60-reselect: STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED, COMPLETION_CHANGE from DOCUMENTING, Request replaced with the reselection and its new stated reason. No documentation record exists. Assertion 0's NOT_ASSESSED intermediate step is left to the judge (trace).
